Claim Notes

Scott Perry

19 May 2025
Claimant reported a rear-end collision at a traffic light and a knee injury; the claim was opened and the vehicle was
assigned for inspection.
20 May 2025
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the collision occurred
as described. The other driver's account matches.
7 Aug 2025
Photos from the scene and the vehicle inspection show damage mostly in line with the described impact. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The driver is
named on the policy.
29 Aug 2025
Claimant reports a knee injury consistent with a crash of this type. Medical records show a prior minor strain in the
same area years ago that healed fully, which is noted for context.
21 Sep 2025
Claimant added a few small details in a follow-up call, such as the seating position and the sequence of braking. The
core account of the accident remained the same as the first report.
27 Oct 2025
Treatment followed a usual course for this kind of injury, with physiotherapy and follow-up visits. Care tapered off as
the claimant improved, and the treating provider's notes reflect steady recovery.
10 Dec 2025
Based on the collision facts, witness statements, photos and medical timeline, the reported injury is plausible for this
crash. File is progressing to evaluation with no open coverage questions.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
